## Ingredients
- 400 g of cuttlefish ready for cooking and their ink sacs
- 280 g of rice
- 2 garlic cloves
- 2 tablespoons of tomato paste
- 9 dl of fish stock
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 10 g of butter
- 20 g of sour butter
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Cut the cuttlefish into large strips.
2. Heat the oil in a pan, add the peeled garlic and let it wilt for 4 minutes.
3. Remove the garlic, add the cuttlefish and let them flavor for 3-4 minutes; moisten with 1 dl of water in which you have dissolved the tomato paste, then adjust the flame and cook for 30 minutes.
4. Add the ink sacs and continue cooking for 10 minutes, moistening with a little hot broth.
5. In a saucepan, melt the butter and toast the rice for one minute.
6. Bring it to cooking by gradually pouring the necessary boiling broth.
7. Add the sour butter and the cuttlefish, adjust with salt, mix and serve at the table.
